content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Pathway to CAPM Certification in Biloxi

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you hold a secondary diploma or equivalent and meet PMI's education requirement. No prior project management work experience is required—making CAPM accessible to career-changers and early-stage professionals entering Biloxi's growing project-driven sectors.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. Our intensive format covers PMBOK® Guide essentials and exam domains, delivered by experienced instructors who understand the pace and rigor needed to prepare you for certification success.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Create your PMI account, document your completed education hours, and submit your official application. Pay the associated exam fee directly to PMI to activate your eligibility window and secure your exam seat.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-prep resources, practice questions, and study guides to reinforce PMBOK® concepts. Schedule your exam through Pearson VUE, then sit for the computer-based assessment at an authorized testing center.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) throughout the three-year renewal cycle by attending training, conferences, or volunteer project work. Renew your credential before expiration to keep your CAPM active and competitive in Biloxi's job market.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.
